item.text: {"analysis":"The supplied failures show repeated damage during each crossing, with more damage at finer steps. StepShots clears the projectile's hit set on every collision instead of recording the target. Record each hit in that set; the existing clear at the outward-to-return transition then allows one hit per target on each leg. This proposal has not yet been verified by the host.","edits":[{"path":"Assets/Dex/Runtime/DexArena.cs","find":"if(m.owner.f.champion==\"Ezreal\"&&m.slot==1&&u.minion)continue;m.hit.Clear();","replace":"if(m.owner.f.champion==\"Ezreal\"&&m.slot==1&&u.minion)continue;m.hit.Add(u);","create":false}]}
